name: WLAN Monitor
author: uBruckhaus
description: See who is on your Wi-Fi from the bar: every device with a type icon and plain-language status, your own names, alerts when a new device joins, groups by platform, type or Wi-Fi band, a network map (router, bands, repeaters, devices) and FRITZ!Box mesh details. Active scans only on networks you trust.

barWidget.description: Devices on your Wi-Fi, router access, signal and traffic
